integrity: The infinite-parameter claim is established by direct graph-theoretic argument. Bounded enumeration is corroboration only. Sources are identified by traceable DOI or arXiv identifiers. Literature search does not establish global novelty or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Enumeration concerns single edge-open packing subsets of matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs, including the empty subset by polynomial convention. It does not enumerate whole injective edge colorings, and it is not claimed for arbitrary sparse bipartite graphs.
title: Edge-open packing profiles of matching-deleted bicliques
